summary: Frontend-only retest at 1920x1080 using keyboard D-pad events. All requested items pass. (1) Home loads with StageHero, the filmstrip track, film cards and stage-primary-action, with no console or page errors. (2) NEW FIX: after moving Right or Left in the strip, ArrowUp to the tabs and then ArrowDown returns focus to the .film--selected card. Checked in all 3 groups and at several positions (recent: movie-1 and movie-2; series: show-2 and show-1; continue: cw-2). 6 of 6 passed. (3) Left/Right stay inside the strip and stop at both edges. PageDown/PageUp switch groups and focus the new group's first card. (4) Down from the stage lands on the aria-selected tab (continue at first, series after PageDown x2). (5) Enter on movie-2, movie-1 and show-1 opens the detail page. Escape and Backspace return to Home with focus restored to the same card (3 of 3). (6) Up path: series tab -> stage-primary-action -> nav-home, so the iteration_4 issue where the Series tab jumped to Library is fixed. Up from the view toggle also goes to the stage. Nav Left/Right and Enter open Movies (3 titles), TV (2 shows) and Library/Settings, and each page loads with focus on its first item.

issues: The 'Sample Show' poster is a flat maroon block with no title art. This looks like the poster is a solid frame from the synthetic media, while 'Other Series' uses the styled fallback. Cosmetic only.
The selected card's label sits lower than its neighbours.
Fallback cards repeat the title inside the art and below it.
4K UI scale has not been addressed.

critical_code_review_comments: spatial.ts: the prefer-selected redirect in pickNext only applies when the target container does not contain `from`, so moving inside the strip is unaffected. This is correct.

Escape on a page reached from the nav (e.g. Settings) does history back to the previous page (/shows), not to Home. This is acceptable browser-style behaviour; confirm it is the intended controller UX.
seed_data_creation: None. No data was changed. Detail pages were opened but the player was not started.
